top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) recognises targeted protein degradation as a programmable chemical reaction: a bifunctional molecule forms a ternary complex whose cooperativity can be measured and designed, and the concept has been reproduced independently across many laboratories and target classes. The three-name allocation follows the PROTAC design-principle line and the citation makes no clinical claim; the omission of the molecular-glue strand is a real cost but defensible. P002 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is a mature, cleanly attributed method with a real chemical advance over the 2010 couplings, so I rank it above no award, but it is a refinement of a recognised field rather than a new capability.
